$schema_note: Single source of truth for gameplay constants. 1 world unit = 1 in-fiction foot. 'boardInches' fields are physical tabletop measurements; convert with boardInches * scale.inchesPerBoardInch / 12. Collision & ground-detection semantics: see 07-collision-and-ground.md. pos = player FEET; camera = pos + eyeHeight.

scale.anchorNote: Scale factor 64 derives from the clean 8.0 ft lore anchor (96 in / 1.5 in model). The in-game Primaris BODY uses 8.5 ft (armoured lore ceiling). This ~6% mismatch is a deliberate, documented decision — see 01-scale-system.md 'The 8.0 vs 8.5 anchor'. Do not re-derive scale from the 8.5 body height.

spawn.facingNote: Forward vector = toward board center (+Z). Board Z spans -160..+160; spawn sits 15 units inside the short edge, i.e. a deployment-zone feel.
spawn.defaultBodyNote: Start in the hero body so the signature mechanic (jump pack) is available immediately; swapping DOWN to Guardsman delivers the scale shock.
spawn.respawn: Same point + facing. Trigger: falling below respawnPlaneY, set just ABOVE the visual room floor so the player never lands on or clips through it.
spawn.roomFloorNote: Visual scenery only — excluded from collidables AND groundRaycastGroup (07 §7.2). Prevents pack-rescue soft-locks off the table edge. A walkable room floor is an explicit future option, not v1.

collision.groundRayPattern: 5 down-rays: center + 4 offsets at 0.7 x capsuleRadius, origins at feet + stepHeight
collision.wallBand: AABBs block horizontally only within [feet + stepHeight, feet + heightUnits]; lower obstacles are auto-stepped

jumpPack.groundedCheckNote: Grounded is checked at KEYDOWN (strict, no coyote — 07 §7.4). The pack fires at the 0.5 s threshold even though the tap-jump usually has the player mid-air by then; the launch velocity OVERRIDES current velocity entirely (mandatory, see 03 §3.1).

footprints.setNote: Official 11th-edition standard competitive set: 16 pieces, 5 shapes. Dimensions in board inches; multiply by 5.3333 for world units.

controls.jump: Space (tap = normal jump; hold >= holdThresholdSeconds = jump pack if hasJumpPack)

rejectedLoreAccurateSpeeds.note: For reference only — do NOT implement. Tabletop-faithful movement (6 board inches per round, 5 rounds ~= 3-5 minutes of fiction) yields 0.36-0.61 mph, i.e. ~0.1-0.18 units/sec. Unplayable.
